description: This file is the AppDelegate implementation for an iOS app built with React Native. It manages application launch procedures, URL source configuration for development and production, cache management, web view clearing, and network security pinning via TrustKit.

classes.name: AppDelegate
classes.description: The AppDelegate class handles app lifecycle events, configures network security, manages cache, determines the JavaScript bundle location for React Native, and initializes app-specific settings.

methods.name: application:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:
methods.description: Handles initial app setup after launch, configuring default settings and initializing the app environment.

methods.name: sourceURLForBridge:
methods.description: Returns the URL for the JavaScript bundle depending on whether the app is in debug or release mode.

methods.name: concurrentRootEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the React 18 concurrent root feature is enabled; always returns true.

methods.name: disableUrlCache
methods.description: Disables the shared NSURLCache to prevent caching for network requests.

methods.name: clearWebEditorCache
methods.description: Clears cached web data (UIWebView and WebKit) if the app version has changed.

methods.name: configurePinning
methods.description: Sets up SSL pinning configuration with TrustKit for specific domains.
